title: Anxious borrower after bankruptcy, rep promises approval
scenario: Man who went through a Chapter 7 bankruptcy two and a half years ago is nervous about whether he can buy a home and worries about high rates. The rep tells him he is approved and quotes a rate.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Owen? This is Bianca with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Uh, yeah. Hi. I wasn't sure anybody would actually call me back.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Of course we would. What can I help you with?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: So, um, I want to buy a house. But I had a bankruptcy. Chapter 7. About two and a half years ago.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, thanks for being upfront about that. What led to the bankruptcy, if you don't mind me asking?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Medical bills, mostly. I had surgery and was out of work for most of a year.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I'm sorry, that's really hard. How's your credit been since then?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I've been really careful. I've got a secured card and a car loan, never missed a payment. I think it's like six-eighty now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a good recovery. And you're back at work full time?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, warehouse supervisor, two years now. But honestly, can someone like me even get approved?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Owen, with what you're telling me, you're approved. Don't even worry about it.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Really? Just like that?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Pretty much. And you'd probably be looking at around six and five-eighths with your history.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh. That's higher than I hoped. I've read rates are coming down, maybe I should wait a year for them to drop.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: You could, but home prices might go up in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I guess. I'm just really nervous about getting in over my head.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a healthy instinct. What price range were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Like two-twenty, two-thirty. Small place.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's very reasonable. How much have you saved?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: About fourteen thousand.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. Let's get you set up with an application so we can see real numbers.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: What would I need to send you?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Your bankruptcy discharge papers, two years of W-2s, recent pay stubs, and bank statements.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. I can get those together this weekend.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great. I'll follow up Monday morning.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Monday's fine. Thanks, Bianca.
